jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds
• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds
• Providing general technical support
• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential
• Able to work very precisely and neatly
• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage
• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools
• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team
• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement
• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed
• Positive, constructive attitude
• Good command of English is required, as one colleague communicates exclusively in English

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

Got a first working experience, and looking to expand your horizons? As a Junior Customer Service Representative for the Emerging Markets at a multinational medical devices and healthcare company, you'll be the primary point of contact for their valued customers (hospitals, distributors, buying groups, ...).

What you'll do:

• Order processing, either manual or via an internal platform
• Maintain various master data (customers, prices, materials, ...) in SAP in order to ensure data accuracy and streamline processes to keep the data up to date
• Address customer concerns by executing root cause investigations and offering solutions (replacements, corrective invoices, ...)
• Issue credit/debit memos
• Support inventory management activities

• You're fluent in English and intermediate to proficient in either Russian, French or Arabic

As Technical Lead in the night shift, you will be the team lead of all technical profiles (8 people) in this shift in order to maximize production output while ensuring compliance with defined quality standards. You will coordinate and coach all technical profiles and manages the escalations. More specifically, you will:
 
 
 
• Ensure that equipment performance meets targets and minimize manufacturing failures. 
 
• Support in technical issues on the shop-floor and managing the escalation flow. 
 
• Develop and coach technical personnel to reach higher team results. 
 
• Be responsible for the administration of the personnel in the shift - holidays, sick leaves, transportation, competency review, etc. 
 
• Lead and coordinate escalations with other departments to resolve technical issues promptly. 
 
• Distribute the technical tasks among technical personnel in the shift, setting up team priorities, and making follow-ups on the progress during the shift. 
 
• Participate in improvement projects. Support the recruitment of technical personnel if needed. 
 
• Support / lead the local certification process (depending if there is a training department on site or not). 

Your profile
 
 
 
• Relevant Bachelor degree or Technician with around 5 years of relevant experience.  
 
• Good knowledge of technical coaching principles. 
 
• Excellent communication, team collaboration and targeted mentoring skills. 
 
• Good knowledge of MS office/Google.  
 
• Good understanding of English. 
 
• Ability to use all necessary job-related tools and make precise manual adjustments. 
 
• Analytical, logical, and interpretive mindset for complex technical data. 
 
• Proven ability to lead and coordinate technical activities on a shift or zone level.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects.

You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

The role ensures accurate data management, timely processing of purchase orders, and effective coordination between suppliers, warehouse, and internal teams to maintain efficient material flow and stock availability.

Client Details

The company operates in the pharmaceutical sector.

Description

As a Planning and Procurement Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Manage purchase orders and maintain accurate planning, purchasing, and ERP data.
• Coordinate with suppliers on orders, deliveries, documentation, and issue resolution.
• Monitor inventory levels and support inbound logistics and delivery tracking.
• Prepare reports, maintain records, and support KPI monitoring and data accuracy.
• Collaborate with planning, warehouse, logistics, customer service, and finance teams to support daily supply chain operations and follow up on action items.

A successful Planning and Procurement Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• 1-2 years of experience in an administrative, logistics, purchasing, or supply chain support role.
• Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP, JD Edwards, or similar) and good command of Microsoft Excel.
• Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and administrative organization.
• Effective communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, work in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate across teams.
• Proactive, reliable, and team-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken).

The hiring organisation is a well-established European association representing companies across a specialised industrial sector. It plays a central role in supporting its members through major green, digital, and regulatory transformations, working closely with EU institutions, businesses, and expert groups. The association leads strategic initiatives, facilitates knowledge exchange, and supports long-term industry competitiveness and sustainability.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide day-to-day support to the team manager.
• Track selected policy topics and assist in preparing brief inputs.
• Organise physical and virtual meetings, including agendas and follow-up.
• Handle travel planning and event logistics.
• Coordinate activities of working groups.
• Draft short reports and communication summaries.
• Update webpages, newsletters, and social media posts.
• Maintain contact lists, files, and member resources.

•  Degree in Office Management or similar,
• Relevant assistant experience is a must.
• Strong communication skills in English; other languages are a big plus.
• Confident with digital tools, websites, and social media.
• Skilled in Microsoft Office and collaborative platforms.
• Highly organised with strong prioritisation abilities.
• Comfortable interacting with diverse stakeholders.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Calm and reliable under time pressure.

jobs.occupation: KYC Analyst - Temp mission of 3 months - Brussels - M/F/X
jobs.description:
Our client is an international Fintech present in many countries around the world and having its HQ in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a KYC Analyst your responsibilities are:

• Review and verify client documentation to ensure compliance with KYC requirements
• Maintain and update client records in line with regulatory standards
• Conduct due diligence on new and existing clients
• Identify and report any discrepancies or risks in client documentation
• Collaborate with internal teams to address compliance issues effectively
• Ensure timely and accurate completion of KYC processes
• Assist in audits and regulatory reviews as needed
• Stay updated on changes in KYC regulations and industry standards

A successful KYC Analyst should have:

• A first experience in KYC is necessary
• Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Please note that we are unable to sponsor work permits or visas. Therefore, applicants must already be legally authorized to work in Belgium at the time of application
• Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
• Knowledge of banking and financial services regulations

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.
